title: Synthesis and structural characterization of 3d–4f heterometallic coordination polymers: from cluster to chain

material_class.structural_family: Mn2Ce3 pentanuclear 3d–4f acetate/oxo cluster linked by Na+ into a 1D chain

synthesis.procedure: (NH4)2[Ce(NO3)6] (6.78 g, 12.4 mmol) was dissolved in H2O–HOAc (v/v = 7:2, 9 mL). Mn(OAc)2·4H2O (2.02 g, 8.2 mmol) was dissolved in H2O–HOAc (v/v = 4:1, 5 mL). The Mn solution was added to the Ce solution and the mixture was stirred for 30 min at room temperature. Then 20 mL of 0.4 M NaOAc containing freshly prepared K12[H2P2W12O48]·24H2O (1.5 g, 0.38 mmol) was added. The red-brown mixture was stirred for 24 h at room temperature, filtered, and allowed to evaporate in air at room temperature. After one month, red tetragonal prism crystals of 1 were isolated (36% yield based on Mn).

reagents.name: acetic acid
reagents.amount: in mixed aqueous acetic acid (v/v 7:2, 9 mL and v/v 4:1, 5 mL)

synthesis.time: stirred 30 min, then 24 h; crystals after 1 month
synthesis.vessel_or_method: conventional solution synthesis with air evaporation crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtration followed by evaporation in air at room temperature; red tetragonal prism crystals after one month

properties.summary: Variable-temperature susceptibility of 1 is dominated by two Mn(IV) ions (Ce(IV) diamagnetic). χmT at 300 K is slightly below the spin-only value for two uncoupled S = 3/2 Mn(IV) centers and decreases on cooling; Curie–Weiss fitting gives a negative Weiss constant, indicating antiferromagnetic interactions.

measurements.name: χmT
measurements.conditions: 300 K, 1000 Oe; slightly lower than 3.75 cm3 K mol−1 expected for two uncoupled Mn(IV) (g = 2.0, S = 3/2)

measurements.name: Curie constant C
measurements.conditions: Curie–Weiss fit of χm−1 vs T over 2–300 K

measurements.name: Weiss temperature Θ
measurements.conditions: Curie–Weiss fit over the whole measured temperature range

material_class.structural_family: MnNd2 3d–4f acetate chain linked by Na–O–Na dimers into a 2D array

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the same procedure as 1 except that (NH4)2[Ce(NO3)6] was replaced by Nd(NO3)3·6H2O (5.43 g, 12.4 mmol). Pink block crystals were isolated (40% yield based on Mn).
synthesis.time: same as 1: stirred 30 min then 24 h; crystals isolated after evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: same workup as 1; pink block crystals

properties.summary: χmT of 2 at 300 K is slightly above the value expected for one Mn(II) (S = 5/2) plus two Nd(III) ions. Curie–Weiss fitting gives a negative Weiss constant, indicating antiferromagnetic coupling. χmT decreases from 300 to 9 K (crystal-field depopulation of Nd(III) Stark levels plus AF Nd···Mn/Nd···Nd interactions) then slightly increases from 9 to 2 K, attributed to weak intramolecular ferromagnetic interactions.

measurements.name: χmT
measurements.conditions: 300 K, 1000 Oe; expected 7.65 cm3 K mol−1 for one Mn(II) (g = 2.0, S = 5/2) and two Nd(III) (g = 8/11, J = 9/2)

measurements.name: Curie constant C
measurements.conditions: Curie–Weiss fit of χm−1 vs T over 2–300 K

measurements.name: Weiss temperature Θ
measurements.conditions: Curie–Weiss fit over the whole measured temperature range
